instruction: Fix `safe_write` so it creates the parent directory of the target file before opening it (writing into a non-existent directory currently fails).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/fileops.py b/fileops.py
--- a/fileops.py
+++ b/fileops.py
@@ -42,6 +42,7 @@
 
 def safe_write(path, content):
     """Write ``content`` to ``path``, creating the file."""
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path) or ".", exist_ok=True)
     with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
         f.write(content)
